title: Climate Region
label: Bioclimates
tooltip: In the context of ecosystem settings, climate regions are areas of similar average temperatures and precipitation levels over the course of a typical year.

items.tooltip: Areas without frost and the daily mean annual temperature ranges from 24°C (75°F) to 34°C (93°F), and the relative moisture expressed as aridity index is 0.65 or higher, which means irrigation is not required to grow crops.
